LIRON REALTY, INC., a New York corporation, having an office at c/o Shalom Azani, 2025 Broadway, Apt 28B, New York, NY 10023 ("Transferor"), to VALERAY REAL ESTATE COMPANY, INC., a New York corporation, having an address at c/o Roy J. Bernstein, Esq., 666 Fifth Avenue, Suite 1401, New York, New York 10103 (*"Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner in fee of certain land, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 28 in Block 692 on the Tax Map oftheCityofNewYork,andasandbythestreetaddress509West20thStreet,NewYork,New York,and more particularly described onExhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferor Lot"); WHEREAS,Transfereeis theownerinfee of that certain landlocated in theBorough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lots 1, 9 & 18 in Block 700 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses of 282-290 Eleventh Avenue, 529-545 West 28th Street, and 517-527 West 28th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferee Lot"); WHEREAS, the Transferor Lot is a“granting site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the“Zoning Resolution") and the Transferee Lot is a “receiving site,” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the “floor area,” as defined in § 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Transferor Lot includes 23,080 square feet of floor area that is unused and available for transfer under § 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of ten ($10.00) dollars, lawful money of the UnitedStates,and othervaluable consideration paidby Transferee,Transferor does herebygrant, Transferee Lot, subject to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, 23,080 square feet of floor area, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity oftheTransfereeLot. Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive the consideration paid by Transferee for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to the payment of the cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purposes. At the request and expense of Transferee, Transferor covenants that it will execute or procure any further necessary assurances of its rights to make the within transfer. 1
